acquisition method: The mass spectrometer was operated in a data-dependent acquisition mode, where one full-scan MS (m/z 300–2000) was followed by MS/MS scans on the 20 most abundant ions found in full-scan MS.
alkylation reagent: alkylated with iodoacetamide (55 mM) at room temperature in the dark for 0.5 h.
alkylation concentration: alkylated with iodoacetamide (55 mM) at room temperature in the dark for 0.5 h.
cleavage agent: The solution was then incubated with trypsin at an enzyme/substrate ratio of 1:50 (w/w) at 37 °C overnight.
enrichment method: the ensuing desthiobiotin-conjugated peptides were enriched with streptavidin beads for LC-MS/MS analysis.
instrument: Q Exactive Plus quadrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometer
injected for LC-MS/MS analysis on a Q Exactive Plus quadrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
labeling: developed a chemoproteomic strategy, based on the use of isotope-coded desthiobiotin-perfluorooctanephosphonic acid (PFOPA) probe and liquid chromatography with tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) analysis, to profile PFAS-binding proteins.
reduction reagent: reduced with dithiothreitol (20 mM) at 37 °C for 60 min
reduction concentration: reduced with dithiothreitol (20 mM) at 37 °C for 60 min
